name: get_device_detail
description: Fetch one device/group's FULL specification: every property/command's exact display name (properties/accepts/sends), plus each one's uom, precision, min/max, and enum key/label pairs, and each command parameter's real id. DEVICE DATABASE deliberately omits all of this (names only, to stay compact) -- call this tool for every device you're about to reference in create_or_update_routine's DSL, before writing any status()/was_controlled()/command()/param() call for it. Use the exact display name shown here for a property or command (e.g. .status("Status", ...), .command("On")) -- never the parameter's id, and never guessed -- the backend resolves the real property/command id server-side. Not needed for get_property/send_command, which already resolve names on the backend.

device_id.description: The device/group's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE.
